The reference anchor is Domino's, where the restaurant brand also functions as a dough manufacturing and food distribution platform for franchisees. The underfollowed lane shifts attention to companies that may capture second-order economics when smaller chains lack internal procurement scale: private-label coffee and beverage suppliers, foodservice ingredient manufacturers, and high-dependency restaurant input suppliers such as frozen potato processors.
